subject.title: fix(onboarding): make fresh AI setup reliable and transparent

question: Is the focused Testbox and earlier signed-package evidence sufficient to merge before running the exact-head fresh CLI/macOS and existing-config user-path matrix?
rationale: The code and focused validation are strong, but the PR explicitly defers its broad real-user matrix until after merge for a P0, compatibility- and auth-sensitive onboarding change.

options.title: Require exact-head matrix
options.body: Run and link the fresh CLI/macOS and existing-config scenarios on the rebased exact head before merge.

options.title: Accept post-merge validation
options.body: Merge with the current focused evidence and explicitly own rollback or urgent follow-up if the post-merge matrix finds a regression.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head matrix
recommendation.body: Run and link the fresh CLI/macOS and existing-config scenarios on the rebased exact head before merge.
